industry: Real estate development and property management

sources.name: Yardi Voyager
sources.notes: Property, lease and tenant data via Yardi export API

sources.name: Oracle E-Business Suite
sources.notes: Finance GL, AP, AR via direct JDBC with incremental watermark

sources.name: SharePoint Excel files
sources.notes: Budget and forecast workbooks maintained by finance

data_volume: About 1.5 TB initial, growing roughly 20% a year
ingestion_cadence: Daily batch, finance sources every 4 hours during month end
consumption: 12 Power BI dashboards (Leasing, Occupancy, Collections, Sales Pipeline, Finance P&L, Cash Flow and others), 3 certified semantic models, RLS by community and business unit, mobile layouts for leadership

governance.notes: Catalog, glossary, lineage and sensitivity labels for tenant PII

brief: Crestline runs leasing in Yardi, finance in Oracle EBS and sales in Salesforce. Reporting today is manual Excel consolidation that takes 6 to 8 days at month end. Leadership wants a single governed data platform with self-service Power BI and wants tenant data protected.
